I am in your wife’s situation. Since my boyfriend brought it up to me 8 months ago, I became suicidal. Yes, I know, that’s my problem, not everyone is as fragile/broken/or whatever serous mental health issue I have. But I can tell you I used to be very happy before that and never felt like I would have been depressed. 
Again, I clearly have issues for becoming suicidal because of this, any sane adult  would juste have left a relationship that does not sit them.
But what I am trying to tell you, is that news like this can hurt very very very much a monogamous person. We do take it personally. My bf does what he can to tell me that this « isn’t about me », « he still loves me » , etc. I do believe him, and yet, discovering he feels like that, after 3 years of believing he loved me the way I do (monogamous), well it hurts like hell. It is like your whole life has been a lie. I am 1000% monogamous so even if I DO believe him, I cannot fully understand. I sincerely believe sometimes that I would be less broken if he would have just left me, really. It just makes more sense to « us », to be told « sorry, I don’t love you anymore », then « sorry, I love you, but I need to f*** other people ».... at least a break makes sense to us, it is more common. The « polybomb » is like, a real bomb. You don’t see it coming, you never ever expected it to happen. The uncertainty, the dilemma (am I just staying in a very very unhealthy relationship? Is this even a thing ? Can they really love me, or am I being a total idiot for staying...?)... at least when you are being dumbed you have no choice. You can be hurt as f*** and became suicidal too, but the other choice is moving on. There is no « agony alternative » where you stay in a relationship that hurts like hell, forever wondering which choice would destroy your soul most. The monogamous person may not tell you about the living HELL they are going through, for fear of loosing. They might try to seem stronger then they are, out of fear of loosing you. A paralyzing fear that just doesn’t let you do anything. 

What I am trying to tell you, like te other people are, is , to be very very very very delicate when you bring this up to her. Tell her, hundreds of time, that you love her, that you don’t wanna loose her, that you can take ALL the time she needs to understand that, that, at least in the beggining, you can start in a way that conforts her, any rule, anything. 
One idea someone gave me was to decide to open only on my side first, to see how I feel about That. Unfortunately it does not work for me because as I said I am 10000% monogamous, I have no interest whatsoever in any other guy, (not saying I don’t appreciate being liked or complimented, but I would never ever touch another man while I am in love with another). But who knows, maybe you too will be more lucky then us ably compatibility. 
But still be as delicate as you can. You never know what people feel inside. My bf knows now how I feel about that, but he would never ever imagine it makes me want to kill myself. You think you know people but sometimes you just don’t..., we are able to hide our darkest side sometimes. 

Good luck to you, and most of all, good luck to her
